description.value: Cooks Restaurant is a gourmet smash burger joint on Cumberland's historic former mining town main street, operated by chefs Jake Galbraith and Christopher Matthews. It was called a 'worth-the-detour' destination by the Vancouver Sun, serving freshly ground local chuck burgers, fried chicken sandwiches, hand-spun milkshakes made with Island Farms dairy, and local draft beer. Cumberland itself is a well-known cycling hub, making this a natural post-ride stop.
